name: Boeing 777
summary: Largest twinjet in common service, flown by United and American and as the 777F by FedEx, Atlas and Kalitta.

wings: Square plain tips on the -200/-200ER; long raked tips on the -300ER, -200LR and 777F
engines: Two enormous circular nacelles (GE90, Trent 800 or PW4000) — the biggest on any twin
Each nacelle is roughly as wide as a single-aisle airliner's fuselage
fuselage: Rounded nose with a sloping windshield
tail: Tailcone ends in a flattened vertical blade-like edge

tellTales: Six wheels on each main-gear bogie
Gigantic round engines on a long twin

confusedWith.howToTell: The 777 has a blade-like tailcone and raked or square tips; the A350 has curling blended winglets and a black 'raccoon mask' around its cockpit windows.
The 777 has six-wheel bogies, smooth nacelle exhausts and a blade tailcone; the 787 has four-wheel bogies, serrated exhausts and a smooth 4-pane nose.
The 777 has six-wheel bogies and much bigger engines; the A330 has four-wheel bogies and small angular winglets.
The 777 has two engines and no hump; the 747 has four engines and a raised upper deck.
